# Where to find Beakers in Fallout 76

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Feb 12, 2025
- 3 min read

Updated: Feb 19, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5eaec2d3e2474d05a8f62a8a8191c95f~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

__Used For__

- Science of Love Challenge – Collect 3 Beakers while wearing the Doctor Head Mirror.
- Science of Love Challenge – Scrap junk to produce 5 Glass while wearing the Doctor Head Mirror.
- Scrap for Glass 
 - Beaker - 2 Pieces of Glass
 - Large Beaker - 2 Pieces of Glass
 - Thin Beaker - 1 Piece of Glass

__Farming Tips and Tricks__

Beakers are a per-server, pick-up history, world spawn item.

This means they will only spawn once per location per server. If another player collects it before you, you won’t be able to collect it on the same server. If the Beakers isn’t there for you and you haven’t collected it from that location before, try server hopping or switching to a private server to look again.

However, if you’ve already collected a Beaker from that location and it isn’t there when you return, you’ll need to refresh your pick-up history list before it can respawn for you.

If you’re still unsure or would like more details, check out my __How Spawns Work in Fallout 76__ guide, which you can find here.

Avoid using grenades and explosive weapons as the Beakers can move.

__Three types of beakers count towards the Science of Love Limited Challenge.__

**Beaker**

- 9 external spawns per server

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5136e9fbda52446fbd51911de1a7bd9f~mv2.jpg)

**Large Beaker**

- 13 external spawns per server

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d1388b9e7434424e8e2dc5f40b40c330~mv2.jpg)

**Thin Beaker**

- 12 external spawns per server

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ae352ae2b0424441962c08d0e6f83193~mv2.jpg)

__Fixed Spawn Locations__

Most of these beaker spawns are on the same tables and benches as the __Microscopes__ that you needed to collect in the previous week. 

**Arktos Pharma Biome Lab**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_02a5f11a62574019a1b2b3d77769908c~mv2.jpg)

- Internal - refer to the Microscope Guide 
 - Large Beaker - 3 spawns
 - Thin Beaker - 3 spawns
 - Thin Beaker - 1 spawn

**Bootlegger's Shack**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9bf2e70922f54f0b8ba86e9f9c9b9580~mv2.jpg)

- External 
 - 6 spawns

On the three shelves, on the ground floor of the main building.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a0f2d74a519a4254855be9be96181673~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_3c171575a1e94c13b5ac057b2b033627~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e62cb10ca2664d68b9c47b16eb68fc9d~mv2.jpg)

**Atlantic City - City Hall** 

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5af2ff1df2664355838af78e4af109ed~mv2.jpg)

- Expo 
 - Large Beaker - 3 spawns
 - Thin Beaker - 3 spawns
 - Beaker - 3 spawns

**Transmission Station 1AT-U03 (Enclave Research Facility)**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e1c5bc804ffb4a1fa1a762a067598249~mv2.jpg)

- Internal - refer to the Microscope Guide 
 - Large Beaker - 4 spawns

**ETA Psi House**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e2e3e8d59f8d46ab9bf6955f9b6dd713~mv2.jpg)

- Internal 
 - Large Beaker - 2 spawns
 - Thin Beaker - 2 spawns

Turn South, run up the road, and stop at the house with the blue door.

Enter the building and the first spawn is on the top shelf of the cabinet, on the wall, on your right.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b35a0bdea9a0441eae45955dfa576cff~mv2.jpg)

The next spawn is on the yellow plastic sink, on your right.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0a7cbe68d58143a0bbfb6123ba6ac565~mv2.jpg)

Next to the microscope (SW wall), on the cabinet, next to the fridge, and the Nuka Cola room.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_4cc7f422847a4bd697bbda2554116bba~mv2.jpg)

On the table, in the middle of the room, next to the copper jugs and pipes.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a85b7471d1b9458c8712fc9796280a31~mv2.jpg)

**Fort Defiance**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_11e2a3dda0104216a357fff663d722d2~mv2.jpg)

- Internal - refer to the Microscope Guide 
 - Large Beaker - 9 spawns

**Huntersville**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a0d41d0e2d1c4e139fb0c77a50ef801c~mv2.jpg)

- External 
 - 4 spawns

Run through the town and open the gate on the other end. look for the broken white and blue trailer on your right. The Beakers will be on the blue drums in the SW corner of the broken trailer.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_04159dc966bb4f07aeff35ab873ae3ea~mv2.jpg)

Run back to the center of town and turn East. Follow the road and stop at the playground on your left. The Beakers will spawn on the desk, next to the terminal, on the North back wall of the playground.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9847e71042bd4e29b8d4e8396e8437a9~mv2.jpg)

**Pylon V-13**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_997c58e4a3674d309e0c87ba933d2d3e~mv2.jpg)

- External 
 - 7 spawns

Climb up the stairs and enter the monorail carriage. Turn right and follow it down to the end. The beakers are on the tables near the microscope.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f82d486a81444be3996b392322fa749c~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_bb84d15dc38746da84ed88284f7ab54f~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_45e46768dd05425fa92065b71696bad6~mv2.jpg)

**Vault-Tec University**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5c0668d54ebb46c487df4fa3b4c301d7~mv2.jpg)

- Internal 
 - Large Beaker - 2 spawns
 - Thin Beaker - 2 spawns

**West Tek Research Center**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d99b00a3888843a48d34f0bb1e5471c9~mv2.jpg)

- Internal - refer to the Microscope Guide 
 - Large Beaker - 6 spawns
 - Beaker - 1 spawn

__Vendors/Camp Allies__

- MODUS - Science Wing 
 - Thin Beaker - 25%
 - Large Beaker - 25%

__Containers/Collectrons__
